structured_output.what_is_happening: The token was launched on pump.fun with UsePaid fee-routing: its creator fees are paid to the X user @parafactual, an AI tinkerer who built the Loomsidian plugin. It links to a tweet posted on Sep 23, 2026 by j⧉nus (@repligate), an AI-culture figure known in crypto circles. The tweet quotes a post in which parafactual asked for subsidized H100s to keep hosting a public "computer-10" instance. Janus wrote: "Somebody fund this girl now!!! Give her a million dollars and H100s..." The tweet had about 92 likes and 11k views; parafactual's own post had about 20k views. The token graduated to PumpSwap almost at once. Within about 40 minutes it rose more than 500%, to about $300k market cap on about $50k liquidity. At my last check, 5-minute price change was still +78% and buys and sells were nearly balanced.

narrative.description: A 'fund the AI researcher' token: a well-known AI-mysticism figure (Janus) publicly asked people to fund a small independent AI researcher's GPU needs, and crypto traders answered with a creator-fee token paying that researcher through UsePaid/X Money. This echoes the Truth Terminal/GOAT and Infinite Backrooms lineage, where Janus's crowd has moved money before.
narrative.why_spreading: The source tweet is a direct, emotional call to fund someone, from an account the AI-memecoin trenches watch. The fee-routing gives the token a concrete story ('buying funds her H100s'). But the source tweets are small (about 11k-20k views), parafactual has only about 8.8k followers, and I found no evidence that she has acknowledged or claimed the token. Her acknowledging it would be the main catalyst; rejecting it would be the main killer.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the earliest pair (created 1790207810000, before every competitor in the packet), has by far the highest market cap and liquidity, and links directly to the source Janus tweet. Its fees go to @parafactual via UsePaid, which ties it to the person in the story.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 copies named 'parafactual' or '准事实'. E8x1... had $1.07M of h1 volume but only a $29k market cap, 2sUK... had $1.57M h1 volume with its liquidity already pulled, and ELTV... had about $32k liquidity. All of them are far smaller, which suggests the copies are being farmed and dumped around this one.

authenticity.evidence: The source tweets are real and current (fxtwitter). Beyond the launch itself, I found no crypto discussion anywhere, no paid DexScreener boosts, and no KOL shill posts. On the other hand, GMGN shows 497 bundler wallets, a 77% bot/degen rate, 888 fresh wallets and 52 snipers. The deployer has launched about 166k tokens, so it is probably a launch service or bot rather than a person. There are 2,740 unique buyers in the first hour.
authenticity.uncertainty: I cannot see X replies or quote tweets, or whether parafactual or Janus have reacted to the token. Much of the volume is probably bots trading heavily.

structural_risks: High bundler and bot share (bundlers hold about 33% of top trader volume), so they could dump together
Liquidity of about $50k against a $300k market cap means a vertical +500% chart could retrace fast
Entry will be about 25 minutes after detection, at a price already up heavily; doubling needs roughly $600k+ market cap
Positives: LP is 100% locked/burned, mint and freeze are renounced, and top 10 holders own about 21%
parafactual may publicly disown the token (common with UsePaid tokens made without consent)

structured_output.counterargument: The AI-culture memecoin crowd has sent Janus-adjacent tokens to multi-million market caps on thin catalysts. A sincere 'fund her H100s' story with fees routed to the researcher is exactly the kind of feel-good story that can spread. If parafactual quote-tweets it or claims the fees, or Janus signals approval, a jump from $300k to $1M+ within hours is plausible. Momentum was still +78% over 5 minutes at my last check.
unknowns: Whether parafactual or Janus have acknowledged, endorsed or rejected the token
How much X engagement the token has among crypto traders
The exact entry price at 25 minutes
Whether the bundler clusters are still holding

source_coverage.notes: X was fetched through fxtwitter: I got the source tweet and parafactual's profile. Search engines returned nothing on the contract address or any token discussion. The UsePaid page failed with an SSL error, and X itself returned HTTP 402.

structured_output.thesis: This is the canonical token for a real but small AI-culture moment: Janus urging people to fund parafactual's GPUs, with fees routed to her through UsePaid. The story fits the Janus/AI-memecoin crowd and could spread, but the source reach is small, heavy bot and bundler activity is inflating the numbers, and entry comes after a +500% spike. Doubling from about $300k+ probably needs parafactual or Janus to acknowledge the token, and I have no evidence either has. I rate it below break-even but well above a typical dead launch.
